name: Electronic Industries Inc
old_description: Electronic Industries is an authorized distributor for over 50 of the industries top manufactures and an independent stocking distributor for hundreds more.
about:
Electronic Industries Inc operates from Oshkosh, Wisconsin, as a locally owned distributor of electronic components. The company does not disclose its founding year or founders, but it has established itself as an authorized partner for more than 50 leading manufacturers while also maintaining an independent stocking relationship with hundreds of additional suppliers.

The firm stocks a broad range of passive components, connectors and interconnects, circuit protection devices, switches, relays, wire and cable, power conversion modules, and test and measurement equipment. Its online catalog lists thousands of part numbers across categories such as connectors (28,832 line items), switches (32,317), and wire and cable management (7,245). Specific manufacturer part numbers, including WAGO series like WG-249-116 and WG-2004-1201, are available for immediate shipment.

Electronic Industries serves customers in industrial, automotive, marine, datacom, and low-voltage markets. The distributor targets original equipment manufacturers, maintenance and repair operations, and system integrators who require reliable component sourcing across those sectors.

The company emphasizes a customer-centric approach, offering vendor-managed inventory programs, 24/7 technical support, and free local delivery within its service area. These services are positioned as the core differentiators that distinguish Electronic Industries from larger national distributors.
